I grow maize here in the midlands where the rains are good for it, and since this plot is rented I need a decent harvest to pay the landlord and still have grain left for my family. I will buy DAP and urea from the cooperative — not the full package because money is tight, but enough to help the crop — and I will use improved seed since I learned in school that it yields better when paired with fertilizer. My brothers and I will do most of the work ourselves, but I will hire a few day laborers to help with weeding and harvesting when the season gets busy. I do not have chemicals for pests or any way to irrigate, so I am relying on the rains.
